title: Python: key_epoch increment + grace period
description: Increment epoch and allow old key grace period
close_reason: GroupsCollectionResource.rekey() increments key_epoch, retires prior epoch with REKEY_GRACE_S=3600; epoch_accepted() allows old epoch until exclusive expiry. GroupKeyManager.rekey() also increments (u32 wrap at 0xFFFFFFFF) with GRACE_PERIOD_S=3600. pytest tests/coap/test_groups_rekey.py and TestGroupOscoreKeyVectors: 12 passed.
